children: The Instalco subsidiary, Elektro-Centralen AB has signed an agreement for installation of the electrical systems associated with the construction of Kungälv Arena. The work will be carried out as a partnering project with Kungälv Municipality and the general contractor, Vestia Construction Group AB.
The order value for Instalco in the project is approximately SEK 54 million and applies to electrical installations at two ice rinks and a bandy hall in the arena area.

Kungälv Arena is being developed as a new destination for sports, culture and events. The scope of the construction project covers sports halls, ice rinks, a bandy hall, a tennis hall, a swimming facility, and spaces for culture and events. The arena complex will also include community gathering spaces, a café and restaurant, as well as facilities for municipal services.

“We are very proud to be part of this important project, which will contribute to the deveopment of Kungälv Municipality and enhance the quality of life for its residents. The project places stringent demands on both technical and energy-efficient solutions – something that aligns perfectly with our expertise and values. We strongly believe in the partnering model and are confident that, together with Kungälv Municipality and Vestia, we can develop the best possible solution and deliver it with the highest quality – on time and within budget,” says Jonas Toreborg, CEO at Elektro-Centralen.

The project will be delivered through a strategic partnering arrangement, with individual sub-projects proceeding subject to political approval. Elektro-Centralen has been involved in the electrical design for the swimming facility, sports hall and tennis hall at Kungälv Arena. The electrical installation works will be carried out from the end of 2027 to the beginning of 2029.
Fredrik Trahn, Head of Sustainability and Communications Instalco, +46 (0)70-913 67 96, fredrik.trahn@instalco.se
